twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.requireDescription: User will be prompted to set up an authenticator app on next login. This does not enable 2FA by itself.
twoFactor.requireError: Failed to update two-factor authentication requirement
twoFactor.resetDescription: Clears the user's current authenticator setup and recovery codes, and signs them out of all sessions. Use this for account recovery (e.g. lost device).
twoFactor.resetConfirmDescription: This will remove the user's authenticator enrollment and recovery codes, and sign them out of all active sessions. They will need to set up 2FA again.
twoFactor.setUpNowDescription: Scan a QR code with this user's phone right now to enroll them in 2FA in person.
twoFactor.setUpNowSelfDescription: Scan a QR code with your own phone to enable 2FA now. Since this is your own account, you'll need to sign in again afterward.

twoFactorSetup.title: Set Up Authenticator App
twoFactorSetup.instructions: Scan this QR code with {userName}'s authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or Authy), or enter the key manually.
twoFactorSetup.manualEntryLabel: Can't scan the code? Enter this key manually:
twoFactorSetup.confirmCodeLabel: Enter the 6-digit code from their app to confirm setup
twoFactorSetup.recoveryCodesWarning: Hand these to the user now and have them store them somewhere safe. Each code can be used once to sign in if they lose access to their authenticator app. They will not be shown again.
twoFactorSetup.promptDescription: You can walk {userName} through authenticator setup right now by scanning a QR code with their phone, or skip this and let them set it up later from their own account settings.
twoFactorSetup.invalidCode: Invalid or expired code. Please try again.
twoFactorSetup.enabledSuccess: Two-factor authentication enabled for this user
twoFactorSetup.emailVerifyInstructions: That code proves the app is working, but not that it's really theirs. We've sent a one-time code to {maskedEmail} — have them check their inbox and enter it below to finish.
twoFactorSetup.emailCodeLabel: Enter the code sent to their email
twoFactorSetup.emailCodeResent: A new code has been sent to their email.
twoFactorSetup.invalidEmailCode: Invalid or expired code. Please try again or resend.
twoFactorSetup.selfSignInAgainNotice: Since this is your own account, enabling 2FA has signed you out of your current session. Sign in again to continue.
